subject: Request: Pilot scale bump + engineering credit for Bluefront PoC
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@bluefront.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@bluefront.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PoC ask - scale bump + engineering credit

Hi Marissa / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. The team here is excited — we want to expand the PoC to include two additional data sources and run a steady 12k tokens/day workload for the next 4 weeks to validate production performance.

Quick ask: to make the next phase viable for us financially we need a one-time engineering credit (to cover integration work) plus a modest trial credits allocation for the expanded token volume. Our procurement team also asked for the SOW and a short appendix on pricing so they can expedite approval.

Proposed ask:
- Engineering credit: $8,000 applied against professional services or usage
- Trial credits: 50,000 token credits usable during the PoC window
- PoC window: Jan 13 — Feb 9

Can you let me know if Redwood can approve both elements, or what an exec exception would look like? I can loop in our procurement contact (cc'd) for contract redlines.

Appreciate it — Samir

--
Samir Patel
Head of Platform, Bluefront Labs
samir@bluefront.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@bluefront.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PoC ask - scale bump + engineering credit

Samir — thanks for the clear ask. This is doable from the sales side but the engineering credit request is outside standard self-serve allowances, so I need an exec sign-off for an exception.

Notes for approval:
- Business case: Bluefront is an active pipeline account showing potential for expansion to Dedicated capacity in Q2; this PoC is a likely path to a commit.
- Impact: 4-week PoC with ~12k tokens/day will increase hosted cost but will also generate strong usage signals; the requested $8k engineering credit would accelerate integration work and is tied to a signed SOW.
- Alternative offered: $5k engineering credit + 35k token credits if full $8k is not approved.

Attachments: SOW_v1.pdf (draft), PricingAppendix.xlsx (proposed token pricing and overage terms)

Vanessa / Vivek — requesting a one-time exception approval for the combo (engineering credit + token credits). If approved, I will send an updated SOW and a short mutual action plan and get procurement engaged.

Next steps I propose:
1) Exec approval (yes/no) for full ask or alternative
2) If yes, Marissa to issue credit schedule and updated SOW
3) Legal/procurement to complete redlines via DocuSign

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 08:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: PoC ask - scale bump + engineering credit (please advise)

Vivek — forwarding Bluefront's request. Marissa summarizes the business case below.

Key points:
- Account: Bluefront Labs (tight fit for Dedicated in H2)
- Ask: $8k engineering credit + 50k token credits for a 4-week PoC
- Alternative: $5k eng credit + 35k token credits
- Attachments: draft SOW + pricing appendix

Can you weigh in on approval? My recommendation is to approve the alternative ($5k + 35k) unless you prefer the full ask tied to a small marketing rebate from GTM. I don't want to slow the procurement cadence — they're ready to sign with an approved credit schedule.

Vanessa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@bluefront.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 17:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Approved: PoC support for Bluefront Labs (conditional)

Samir — glad to hear the team is moving quickly. I am approving a one-time exception with conditions:

1) Engineering credit: $6,500 applied to integration services (partial of the requested $8k).
2) Trial credits: 40,000 token credits valid for the PoC window (Jan 13 — Feb 9).
3) Condition: Bluefront signs the attached SOW and commits to a short evaluation checkpoint on Feb 2 to review performance and discuss a paid Dedicated pilot in Q2.
4) Approval is contingent on Legal sign-off of the SOW and procurement acceptance of the proposed overage terms in PricingAppendix.xlsx.

Marissa — please issue the credit schedule, update the SOW to reflect the approved numbers, and loop in Legal / Procurement POV. Priyom — please draft a short 1-page credit schedule I can sign off on.

Samir — once the SOW is updated we'll route for DocuSign. Appreciate the clarity of the ask — excited to get the PoC scaled.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai
